justification: Assessment reported INVALID and targeted exactly the ground-truth defect: the bogus Master-theorem Case 1 application to S(m)=S(m/2)+10 log m claiming f(m)=10 log m = O(m^{-0.5}) and hence S=Theta(1). It correctly identifies the reversed ratio test and gives the same refutation (unrolling S(2^k)=5k(k+1) unbounded, true order Theta(log^2 m) via extended Case 2). Witness differs only in base case (S(1)=0 vs 1), which does not change validity.
